title: Strictly Ballroom The Musical - Review
transcript: I love a good musical and while Strictly Ballroom which I thought the West Yorkshire Playhouse might not reach the heights of a Rodgers and Hammerstein's for character and depth of feeling there is an enjoyable love story and some excellent dancing if you like Footloose or dirty dancing you should love this if you don't know Baz Luhrmann's film it's the story of a pair of ballroom dancers determined to express themselves their way even if that means breaking the rules freedom versus the establishment it's always a good story and along the way they inevitably fall in love and equally inevitably face bumps on the road until they finally get together and if that sounds like a formulaic sure don't mean it - it's Lively inventive often funny sometimes moving in any case we don't need the most original story for a musical to work what's most important is the terrific choreography by drew Marconi his work includes last year's brilliant on the town at the open air theatre and the dancing and the scene are impressive throughout some changes have been made to the production before it opens in London but I'm sure that will only make it better I give it four stars you
